name: gildas-rested-ability-reactivation-not-blocked
notes: Gildas (g99PIuhU0O): "[Mordred Bonus] (2), [REST]: Prevent the next 4 damage ..." -- a [REST] cost can only be paid by an awake unit. ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): activateAbilityPrereqs["g99PIuhU0O:0"] (GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php) only checks IsMordredBonusActive() and never that Gildas is awake, and DoActivatedAbility() merely SETS Status = 1 as an implicit REST without checking it first, so the priority window after the first activation still offers 'myField-1@Activate-0@Prevent' and a second activation of the already rested Gildas is accepted: another (2) is paid and a second prevention target is chosen. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin the buggy outcome (4 reserve cards paid in total, Gildas rested).

rulesClauses: [REST] cost: a unit can only pay [REST] if it is awake (an already rested Gildas must not be activatable again).

engineBug.summary: Gildas' [REST] ability can be activated again while Gildas is already rested. The generated activateAbilityPrereqs['g99PIuhU0O:0'] only checks IsMordredBonusActive() and never that Gildas is awake, and DoActivatedAbility() just SETS Status = 1 as the implicit REST without checking it first, so the priority window after the first activation still offers 'myField-1@Activate-0@Prevent' and a second activation of the rested Gildas pays another (2). Confirmed live: CanActivateAbility(1,'myField-1',0) returns true while Gildas has Status 1; the replayed second activation consumed two more reserve cards (hand 7 -> 3).
engineBug.affectedFunction: GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php $activateAbilityPrereqs['g99PIuhU0O:0'] (no awake check) + Custom/GameLogic.php DoActivatedAbility() implicit REST (sets Status without verifying it was awake)
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live: CanActivateAbility(1, 'myField-1', 0) returned true for the rested Gildas, and a temporary file trace in DoActivatedAbility() logged 'card=g99PIuhU0O Status(before implicit REST)=1' for the second activation. Break/restore: adding an awake check to the generated prereq (IsMordredBonusActive && Status == 2) flipped this guard red (memory count 2 instead of the pinned 4) while the awake-Gildas fixtures stayed green; restored, shasums verified.
